content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(CDR-013 Busybox Container Fetches and Executes ELF) AND XQL(CDR-013 Malware ELF Retrieval from Public Repository) — fuses the insecure-deployment ELF retrieval with the egress to the public malware repo into one posture-to-runtime detonation incident, enriched by the DeimosC2/Conti/BPFDoor file-hash IOC matches.
rules.name: Insecure Deployment Detonation — ELF Retrieval Plus IOC Hash Match
